_why: The pin whose game strings predate RL-192's swap (condition 2: the in-game notice word for word, no fix promise, American spellings in ui/data). The live demo is pinned to that commit, so tools/check-site-interim.mjs cannot pass its strings and the Build site job stayed red from 2026-10-27, which hid every other failure behind it. Legal ruled RL-200 (2026-10-28): the excuse ends at the next pin move or on the date in "until", whichever comes first; the check fails once the file is stale in either way, so the file is removed in the same commit as a pin move. It excuses those string rules (the in-game ui/data strings only, never the lock, the routes, the nightly or the page's own notice) for this commit only, in the exported pin's tree only (its build_info.json must name this commit), and only the kinds listed below; the check prints which lines were excused. Every other pin, and HEAD's own strings, are checked in full. Like tools/site-routes-grandfather.json (RL-196).
